title: Playbook Sidebar
body: Understand Use Implement Overview The Sidebar is an in-page navigation component for long-form pages. It is reusable across pages as long as the navigation links and content sections share matching anchor IDs. title: reCAPTCHA v3
body: Overview The BoxLang contact form uses Google reCAPTCHA v3 to protect against spam and automated submissions without displaying a visible CAPTCHA challenge. reCAPTCHA v3 runs in the background and returns a risk score from 0.0 to 1.0 . The application verifies the token, expected action, and score on the server before processing the form submission. Current scope: BoxLang contact form only ( /bxco…
